checks.rule: Named settlement populations must not exceed body/system population; aggregate remainder must be nonnegative.
Every inhabited population requires local food production, imports, or both.
Sealed or hostile habitats require explicit water/air supply and recovery.
Employment plus commuters should remain plausible relative to working-age population.
School seats should scale with dependent/student population.
Remote locations need local stabilization capacity or an explicit referral path.
Material consumption requires recovery, treatment, storage or export.
Named factories require plausible supply paths for major inputs.
External import/export demand should fit port, terminal and warehouse throughput over time.
Municipal services and infrastructure should be supportable by stated revenues/transfers/debt.
Single-point infrastructure failures should be explicit where redundancy is absent.
Gameplay-affecting lore must have structured representation; structured rules should have narrative explanation where player-facing.
